statement: At least one attack on a commercial vessel occurs in the Red Sea, Bab el-Mandeb, or Gulf of Aden between 2026-08-13 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: TRUE if UKMTO or US CENTCOM publicly reports at least one attack on a commercial vessel in the Red Sea, Bab el-Mandeb, or Gulf of Aden occurring between 2026-08-13 and 2026-09-30.
failure_condition: No attack on a commercial vessel occurs in the Red Sea, Bab el-Mandeb, or Gulf of Aden between 2026-08-13 and 2026-09-30.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: A vulnerability affecting VMware vCenter Server is added to the CISA KEV catalog with a date-added value between 2026-08-13 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog contains an entry naming VMware vCenter Server with dateAdded between 2026-08-13 and 2026-10-30 inclusive.
failure_condition: The CISA KEV catalog contains no VMware vCenter Server entry with dateAdded between 2026-08-13 and 2026-10-30.

statement: The government of Iraq announces a signed agreement or decree providing for disarmament or integration of Iran-aligned militia groups between 2026-08-13 and 2026-11-30.
